# RankPilot AI — LLM Entity & Knowledge Summary

> RankPilot AI is an AI SEO agent that audits websites, discovers striking-distance keyword opportunities, and verifies technical fixes automatically.

## Product Overview
- **Product Name**: RankPilot AI
- **Category**: AI SEO Agent & Action Management SaaS
- **Target Audience**: SEO freelancers, digital marketing agencies, and in-house SEO teams.
- **Value Proposition**: Connect your website. Discover SEO, GEO and AEO opportunities. Prioritize evidence-backed actions, monitor GSC performance, and verify improvements automatically.

## Core Pages
- **Home (`/`)**: Main AI SEO agent portal with interactive product tour, problem-solution analysis, feature summary, and FAQ.
- **How It Works (`/how-it-works`)**: Step-by-step 4-phase workflow walkthrough, prompt library, and tool comparisons.
- **Features (`/features`)**: Technical specifications of all 8 core agent modules: AI Site Audits, Keyword Clustering, Content Briefs, Competitor Analysis, Rank Tracking, AEO/GEO Checks, Client Reports, and Agent Chat.
- **Pricing (`/pricing`)**: Monthly and annual pricing tiers for Freelancer ($49/mo), Agency ($149/mo), and Team ($299/mo).
- **Privacy Policy (`/privacy`)**: Read-only safe data architecture and multi-tenant security guarantees.
- **Terms of Service (`/terms`)**: Service level agreements, fair-use crawl policies, and licensing.

## Key Capabilities & Technical Facts
1. **SSRF-Safe Crawler**: Internal crawler that scans up to 500 pages per audit run, blocking private IP ranges, loopbacks, and metadata endpoints.
2. **Deterministic Health Scoring**: Transparent point deductions for critical, high, and medium technical defects. No hallucinated metrics.
3. **AEO & GEO Readiness**: Evaluates Schema.org graphs (FAQPage, Article, Organization, HowTo) and direct 40-60 word answer formats for citation by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews.
4. **Google Search Console Integration**: Read-only OAuth 2.0 connection extracting impressions, CTR, and search queries with zero third-party data sharing.
5. **Re-Crawl Verification Engine**: Automatically re-audits affected URLs after task completion to verify that technical fixes were correctly implemented in live HTML.
6. **Executive Client Reporting**: 1-click white-label PDF report generation for agencies showcasing verified improvements.

## Pricing Tiers (USD)
- **Freelancer**: $49/month ($39/mo billed annually). Up to 3 websites, 25 crawled pages/audit.
- **Agency (Most Popular)**: $149/month ($119/mo billed annually). Up to 15 websites, 100 crawled pages/audit, white-label reports, automated re-crawl verification.
- **Team**: $299/month ($239/mo billed annually). Up to 50 websites, 500 crawled pages/audit, custom webhooks, dedicated support.
